verses.text: Then Eliphaz from Teman answered:
"If someone tries to speak to you, will it upset you? But who can keep quiet?
Think how you have taught many people. You have made weak hands strong.
Your words have helped up those who were falling. You have made weak knees strong.
But now trouble has come to you, and you are discouraged. It touches you, and you are terrified.
Shouldn't your respect for God give you confidence? Shouldn't your honest life give you hope?
Think about it. Has an innocent person ever been destroyed? When have honest people ever been wiped out?
From what I have seen, those who plow evil and plant trouble harvest the same.
God breathes on them and they die. The blast of his anger wipes them out.
The lion may roar and the fierce lion may growl, but the teeth of the young lions are broken.
The old lion dies because it has nothing to hunt, and the cubs of the lioness are scattered.
A message was brought to me secretly. My ears heard a whisper of it.
It came in troubling dreams at night, when people are in a deep sleep.
Fear and trembling took hold of me, and all my bones shook.
A spirit passed in front of my face, and the hair on my body stood up.
It stopped, but I could not tell what it looked like. A shape stood in front of my eyes. There was silence, and then I heard a voice say,
'Can a human be more right than God? Can a person be more pure than the one who made him?
Look, God does not trust even his servants. He finds fault even with his angels.
How much more with people who live in houses of clay, whose foundations are in the dust, who can be crushed like a moth!
Between morning and evening they are broken to pieces. They die forever, and no one even notices.
Their tent ropes are pulled up, and they die without ever gaining wisdom.'
